messages:
maria: Quick design review — small follow-ups on Playground chat UI. Sketch attached: https://figma.com/... TL;DR: proposal to move stop/regenerate into a compact corner control on each message (hover to reveal), change token counter to show session-level + per-message on hover, and prompt library quick-insert pill. Thoughts on keyboard accessibility and discoverability?

sam: I like moving stop/regen into the message chrome — cleans up the global toolbar. Concern: discoverability on mobile where hover doesn't exist. Could we show a tiny persistent icon on small screens?

dave: Accessibility nit: hover-only controls are inaccessible to keyboard users and screen readers. We need a focusable control that's always in the tab order and has an ARIA label. e.g., role="button" aria-label="Stop generation".

anya: Token counter thoughts: session-level counter in the header is useful. For per-reply tokens, hover is okay, but add an explicit label like 'tokens for this reply'. Also consider a subtle color treatment for replies that exceed ~1000 tokens so users notice cost impact.

julia: Prompt library quick-insert should be reachable by keyboard (Cmd+K / or a slash command) and by dragging into the composer. Copy nit: prefer 'Insert prompt' over 'Use prompt' — clearer intent.

maria: Implementation note: POC will render the corner control with tabindex=0 so keyboard can reach it. Quick snippet: 

maria: ```html
<button class='msg-control' tabindex='0' aria-label='Stop generation'>■</button>
```

sam: Also recommend a live region announcement when generation stops/finishes: use role="status" to say "Generation stopped by user" or "Generation complete" for AT.

anya: For the token counter tooltip: use aria-describedby to link to a short explanation and include a small "?" that opens a modal with a one-line explainer: 'Tokens counted are model tokens, not characters.'

julia: UX nit on wording: prefer the longer label 'Regenerate response' (explicit) vs just 'Regenerate'. Keeps it clear in compact menus.

dave: Mobile pattern: long-press on a message to reveal actions (stop, regen, copy, share). Use an affordance for touch-only devices. :iphone: 

maria: Quick poll so I can land the mocks: Option A = always-visible focusable control (in tab order, small icon). Option B = hover reveal but ensure focusable fallback (visible on focus/long-press). React with :one: for A, :two: for B. I want a quick consensus by EOD.

sam: :one: — prefer clarity for new users.

anya: :two: (lean B because it reduces visual noise, but must be keyboard-first).

julia: :one: (also prefer always-visible on desktop, tiny icon is ok).

maria: Thanks team — I'll update the Figma and post updated mocks. Follow-ups I'll add to the PR: accessibility checklist (aria labels, live region), mobile long-press pattern, prompt lib keystrokes + copy. Will aim to post updated screens by end of day. :sparkles:
